说明: 战斗立绘的重画与补图清单。第一批是重画底图：现在这六张站姿一律仰着头看天，战斗里一直昂着下巴，而且六个人的画法各不相同（有的厚涂、有的日系），所以统一改成绢本工笔重彩、平视前方。后面几批是补动作与按兵器分图。所有新图按命名丢进本目录即可生效，不用改代码。

命名.替换兵器装: alt-<动作>-<神仙序号>.webp，例如 alt-ready-0.webp（重锤那一套）
命名.按兵器分的立绘: <兵器形制>-<动作>-<神仙序号>.webp，例如 bow-ready-2.webp
命名.回退: 找不到 <兵器>-<动作> 就找 alt-<动作> 或 <动作>，再找不到就退回 ready / strike，所以永远不会缺图。

出图规矩.画幅: 出图后统一裁成高 288 像素、宽度随姿势自由、脚底压在画布下边缘。仓库里带了工具代劳：godot --headless --path mobile --script res://tests/_fit_art.gd -- <你生成的图> <输出名> [相对身高]。站姿填 1.0，下蹲前扑的姿势按比站姿矮多少填，例如 0.92。
出图规矩.身高: 六个人在游戏里是同一个尺度，所以生成时就要求同样的头身比；不要为了填满画面把人放大。
出图规矩.朝向: 一律三分侧面、面朝画面右侧。
出图规矩.轴心: 待机类（ready / windup / recover / guard / dodge / hurt）人物居中；出招类（strike / cast / follow / victory）人物重心放在画面左起 37% 处，兵器往右甩出。
出图规矩.背景: 真正的透明背景。不要地面、影子、光效、速度线、文字或边框——这些由引擎画。
出图规矩.一致性: 先只生成 0 号（二郎神）的站姿，定稿后把它作为风格参考图附在后面每一张的输入里，再生成其余五人和其余动作，否则六个人会越画越不像一套。
出图规矩.落地后: 跑一次 godot --headless --path mobile --import，再用 tests/_dress.gd 截图核对。

风格基线: Use case: stylized-concept. A single Chinese immortal painted in Ming-dynasty court gongbi style on silk: fine even iron-wire ink outlines of constant weight, flat mineral pigment fills (azurite, malachite, cinnabar, ochre, lead white, touches of gold), built up in thin layered washes rather than modern soft shading. No glossy highlights, no airbrush gradients, no cel-shaded anime rendering, no western digital concept-art painting, no photographic realism. Five or six colors per figure and no more. Quiet aged-silk warmth in the pigments themselves. The silhouette must stay readable when the whole figure is only 100 pixels tall: large simple shapes, broad flat areas, no fussy micro-detail, no tiny props, no busy patterning. Full body, three-quarter side view facing screen right, both feet visible and planted on an invisible ground line at the very bottom edge of the image. Truly transparent background, no ground, no cast shadow, no scenery, no glow, no particles, no text, no border, no second figure.
平视要求: The head is upright and level on the neck. The chin is NOT raised. The eyes look straight ahead toward screen right at their own eye level, a calm composed forward gaze. Do not tilt the head back, do not look up at the sky, do not look down. This applies to every pose including attacks.

重画底图.为什么: 现在的 ready-0~5 与 alt-ready-0~5 都是仰头构图，而角色在挂机和待机时长期显示的就是这一张；strike 那一套的头反而是平的，可作侧面参考。
重画底图.批次: 先做 ready-0~5，这是出场率最高的一张；再做 strike-0~5；最后做 alt-ready / alt-strike。

人物.外形: An adult man in his thirties. Long black hair falling past the waist, gathered into a topknot held by a plain jade ring. A charcoal-brown crossed-collar daopao robe with thin gold piping at the hems, a single gilt beast-mask pauldron on the left shoulder, a dark red waist sash, tall black boots. His weapon is a three-pointed double-edged polearm with a long dark shaft. A faint vertical third eye on the forehead.

An adult woman. Hair coiled high and pinned with a gold phoenix hairpin, the rest falling long down her back. A cinnabar-red fitted bodice, a pale pink silk shawl draped over both arms and trailing, a long layered skirt in soft rose and white. Her weapon is a straight double-edged jian sword with a plain brass guard.

An adult man, broad shouldered, strong bare forearms. Hair bound with a plain dark band and two short feathers. A deep malachite-green hunting tunic over dark trousers, leather bracers and belt, a quiver of fletched arrows on his back. His weapon is a tall recurve bow of dark lacquered horn.

An adult woman. A kingfisher-feather ornament in her coiled hair, the rest falling long. A layered dress of azurite blue and malachite green with a pale gauze shawl, a light quiver at her hip. Her weapon is a slender recurve bow.

An older man with a long black beard and moustache, hair in a Daoist topknot under a small dark crown. A deep indigo robe with very wide sleeves and a white inner collar, a plain cord belt. His weapon is a gilt ritual staff whose head is a stylized thunder-scroll motif.

An adult woman. Hair in double coils pinned with plum blossoms, long strands falling free. Layered violet and lilac robes with a trailing gauze shawl, a pale under-robe. Her weapon is a round bronze thunder mirror held up in one hand.

姿势.ready: <风格基线> <平视要求> <该人物的外形> Pose: standing at ease before the fight. Weight settled evenly, shoulders level and relaxed, the weapon held upright and close beside the body in one hand, the free hand hanging open or resting at the sash. Robes hanging straight with only a slight drift. Composed and watchful, not dramatic. Center the figure in the frame.
姿势.strike: <风格基线> <平视要求> <该人物的外形> Pose: the release frame of one committed attack. The torso is rotated fully into the blow, the weapon has swung out to the right at shoulder height with the arms extended, the front foot is planted wide and the back heel has lifted, robes, sash ends and hair are flung back to the left. The head stays level and the eyes stay on the target to the right. Place the figure's center of mass at 37% of the canvas width so the weapon can reach the right edge.
姿势.alt-ready: <风格基线> <平视要求> <该人物的外形> Replace the weapon with a matched pair of short gilt round-headed war maces with dark wrapped grips, one in each hand. Pose: standing at ease, both maces held low and slightly out from the hips, shoulders level, weight settled. Center the figure in the frame.
姿势.alt-strike: <风格基线> <平视要求> <该人物的外形> Replace the weapon with the same matched pair of short gilt round-headed war maces. Pose: the release frame of a heavy double swing — the lead mace has driven out to the right at chest height, the rear mace is cocked back past the hip, the torso rotated hard, front foot stamped forward, robes and hair flung back to the left. Head level, eyes on the target. Place the figure's center of mass at 37% of the canvas width.

补动作.为什么: 补了图动作就从两帧变成四到六帧；没补之前由 scripts/motion.gd 的关键帧曲线用形变顶着。

条目.prompt: <风格基线> <平视要求> <该人物的外形> Pose: the anticipation frame before a strike. Weight drops onto the back leg, both knees bend, the torso coils back, the weapon shoulder pulls back behind the hip line, the free hand rises to guard the chest. Sleeves, sash ends and hair trail forward because the body just moved backwards. The weapon stays close to the body and fully inside the frame. 相对身高约 0.95。

<风格基线> <平视要求> <该人物的外形> Pose: the follow-through just after the blow has landed. The weapon has swept past the target and now points low and far to the right, arms extended and crossing the body, shoulders rotated past the hips, front foot planted wide, back heel lifted. Robe hem and sleeves still flying to the left. Place the figure's center of mass at 37% of the canvas width. 相对身高约 0.92。

<风格基线> <平视要求> <该人物的外形> Pose: returning to guard. The weapon is being drawn back across the chest, the feet are closing from a wide stance to a narrow one, the spine straightening but not yet settled, one shoulder still slightly forward. Cloth settling downward rather than flying. 相对身高约 0.98。

<风格基线> <平视要求> <该人物的外形> Pose: a low defensive guard. Knees deeply bent, center of gravity low, the body turned more side-on to present a narrow target, the weapon held close and angled across the body like a bar, the free hand low and open. Chin tucked but eyes still level and forward. Cloth hanging heavy and still. 相对身高约 0.90。

<风格基线> <平视要求> <该人物的外形> Pose: pushing off into a backwards evasive slide while still facing right. The front foot kicks out to the right, the body leans back to the left, one arm sweeps out for balance, the weapon tucked tight against the ribs. Robe, sleeves and hair stream strongly to the right because the body is travelling left. 相对身高约 0.93。

<风格基线> <该人物的外形> Pose: recoiling from a hit taken from the right. The head and chest snap backwards to the left, the waist folds, one knee buckles inward, the weapon arm swings loose and out of line, the free hand flies up. Robe and hair whip to the right. A sharp grimace, eyes narrowed. Keep the figure upright enough to stand. 相对身高约 0.93。

<风格基线> <平视要求> <该人物的外形> Pose: releasing a spell. The weapon or staff is raised in the rear hand, the front palm is pushed forward and open at chest height with the fingers in a Daoist mudra, the body square and rooted with the front knee pressed forward. Sleeves blown back from the pushing hand. Solemn and commanding. No drawn magic effect, no glow, no symbols — the engine adds those. Place the figure's center of mass at 37% of the canvas width.

<风格基线> <平视要求> <该人物的外形> Pose: a victory salute after the fight. Standing tall and settled, weight even, the weapon upright beside the body or planted point-down, the free hand folded into a formal Chinese salute at chest height. Calm and composed. Robes hanging straight and still.

选角立绘.文件: portrait-0.webp ~ portrait-5.webp（508×508 或 640×640，不透明背景）
选角立绘.用途: 列仙图录与点将台上的方形立绘，和战斗立绘是同一个人，重画底图后这六张也该一起换，否则选角页和战场上不像同一个人。
选角立绘.prompt: <风格基线，但背景改为：a plain warm aged-silk ground with a faint ink-wash halo behind the figure, no scenery> <平视要求> <该人物的外形> Square composition, the figure from the knees up, turned three-quarters toward the viewer's right but with the face turned to meet the viewer. Calm, dignified, portrait-like. No text, no frame, no border ornament.

建议顺序: 1. 重画 ready-0~5 —— 挂机和待机长期显示的就是这一张，仰头最碍眼，收益最大。
2. 重画 strike-0~5，再重画 alt-ready / alt-strike，六人一套风格统一。
3. portrait-0~5 跟上，选角页和战场上才像同一个人。
4. bow / staff / dual_blades 的 ready 与 strike —— 换兵器终于对得上手里的东西。
5. windup 与 follow —— 普攻、破阵、震退从两帧变四帧。
6. hurt / dodge / recover / guard / cast / victory —— 收尾补齐。
